summary: Master social protection systems and labor market policies. Learn to design resilient social floors and drive formalization. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Social protection and labour market development connect income security with pathways into productive employment. The course is for social protection analysts, employment programme managers and policy advisers who need to assess vulnerability and coverage, design benefits and targeting, and coordinate referrals to employment services. Participants also practise analysing labour market indicators, shaping economic inclusion interventions and measuring programme outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, finance, deliver, evaluate, or coordinate social protection and labour market development policies. It suits intermediate practitioners who already work with programme data, policy processes, employment services, or development initiatives and need a stronger connection between social assistance and labour market outcomes.
modules: Social Protection and Labor Market Foundations
Diagnosing Coverage and Labor Market Risk
prerequisites: You should have working experience in social protection, labour market policy, employment services, skills development, monitoring and evaluation, or development programme delivery. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic programme indicators is useful, but advanced economics, coding, or statistical software is not required. Coding is not required for completion. AI-assisted labour market analysis and digital dashboards are taught at operational application level using provided examples and templates.
